title: ci: show only screenshots of the pages a PR touched

catches.what: a Plan feature change picked the mobile Today screenshots, because / renders today, log and plan; found by running the picker on the real CI screenshots
#37's verification.yaml did not parse as YAML (unquoted ': ' and leading quotes); fixed in the oracle commit
a feature whose spec captured nothing fell back to every screenshot; plus stale comment when nothing is picked, index imports missed, cwd-relative spec path, live PR file list (see PR thread)

human: e2e/evidence.ts records spec relative to Playwright's config rootDir, not process.cwd(): not tested, since it needs a real Playwright run from a directory other than the repo root. Check one PR run's screenshots JSON has spec 'e2e/<name>.e2e.ts', and that nothing runs Playwright from a subdirectory.

The evidence job on real GitHub: compare(base...head) caps the files it lists (about 300, unpaginated here), so a very large PR may lose some picks without warning; the job's if: (always(), artifact-id set) and sparse checkout are enough for the CLI; the fake-gh tests run its shell with bash -e, not the runner's exact shell; the PATCH and POST really render and replace the comment.

Whether showing only the own spec's screenshots, and none when that spec captured nothing, is the right call for reviewers. A failed spec now shows no screenshots, and the reviewer relies on the e2e result in the comment header to notice.
Whether a feature with no spec of its own falling back to every screenshot on its importers' routes is too noisy when the root +layout imports it (it would show all of them).
notes: Self-written tests from the first version were removed; the oracle kept the changesRendering cases and added 20. It ran Stryker unprompted: 9 survivors, all order, equivalent anchors or CLI-only. Rebase onto #37 conflicted on verification.yaml (deleted in #37, edited by this PR's oracle commit); the implementer resolved it by keeping the deletion, so the oracle commit now carries only tests and fixtures.
